There have been 22 prior macro-attempts in this family and 317 prior micro-trials. Hypothesis: token scalars have a different sensitivity structure from the positional table and this minimum-distortion union preserves qualification while yielding 1,790 parameters. It is more informative than the next eligible token union (difference 1.715e-05) because it is the least perturbing test at this new tensor site.
